[[File:TOTJ1-FC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|"Qel-Droma Epics" focused on the life of Jedi Knight Ulic Qel-Droma (pictured).]]
The '''Qel-Droma Epics''' were a series of epic poems that described the stories of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta's]] [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]], the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the life of its central figure, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. For many residents of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], the Epics were taken as literal history, and the [[Great Library of Cinnagar/Legends|Great Library of Cinnagar]] contained a museum dedicated to the Epics.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

In the wake of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the destruction of the Jedi, [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]]
believed that [[Ilia Orpin/Legends|Ilia Orpin's]] "[[Revan Mythologies]]" were an updated derivative reworking of the Qel-Droma Epics to better acculturate [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] of the day.<ref name="NoP" />
